text: This candidate received an overall fit score of 0.2175 for the Senior C++ Engineer position. The strongest evidence for their application is their experience with "REST API", alongside listed experience in C++, AWS, and SQL. Key gaps include a lack of experience with boost, linux, and non-relational databases, as well as a total of 2.54 years of experience which falls below the implied requirement. This profile has been escalated for manual review due to the location mismatch, missing must-have requirements, and a low overall fit score.
